tools.name: spinupwp_list_servers
tools.description: List the servers in your SpinupWP team: name, provider, region, size, IP, Ubuntu version, disk space, connection status and whether a reboot or upgrade is required. GET /servers.

tools.name: spinupwp_get_server
tools.description: One server by id: provider, size, disk usage, database server, connection status, reboot/upgrade-required flags and install notes. GET /servers/{id}.

tools.name: spinupwp_list_sites
tools.description: List sites across your servers (or one server): domain, PHP version, WordPress flag, HTTPS, page cache, backups, pending WordPress core/theme/plugin updates, git deploy settings and status. Deploy-trigger URLs are hidden. GET /sites.

tools.name: spinupwp_get_site
tools.description: One site by id with its full settings: domains, PHP version, page cache, HTTPS, nginx options, database reference, backup schedule and storage, WordPress update counts, git repo/branch/deploy script, basic-auth username, cron and SpinupWP subdomain. The git deploy-trigger URL is hidden. GET /sites/{

tools.name: spinupwp_list_site_domains
tools.description: The additional domains of a site, with their redirect settings (enabled, type, destination). GET /sites/{id}/domains.

tools.name: spinupwp_list_site_path_redirects
tools.description: The path redirects configured on a site (from, to, type permanent/redirect). GET /sites/{id}/path-redirects.

tools.name: spinupwp_list_events
tools.description: List recent events (the activity log: provisioning, restarts, deploys, cache purges) with who started them, status (queued, creating, updating, deleting, deployed, failed) and timestamps. Long command output is shortened; read one event for its full output. GET /events.

tools.name: spinupwp_get_event
tools.description: One event by id, with status and command output. Use it to see whether a purge, restart or deploy (which reply with an event_id) has finished or failed. GET /events/{id}.

tools.name: spinupwp_list_storage_providers
tools.description: The backup storage providers connected to the team (id, service, name). GET /storage-providers.

tools.name: spinupwp_list_team_ssh_keys
tools.description: The team's saved SSH public keys (id, name, fingerprint, public key). Public keys only; read-only. GET /ssh-keys.

tools.name: spinupwp_purge_page_cache
tools.description: WRITE: purge the nginx page cache of one site. Pages are rebuilt on the next visit, so the site may be slower for a moment; nothing is lost. Asynchronous: returns an event_id. POST /sites/{id}/page-cache/purge.

tools.name: spinupwp_purge_object_cache
tools.description: WRITE: flush the Redis object cache of one site (the site must have object caching). The cache refills on demand. Asynchronous: returns an event_id. POST /sites/{id}/object-cache/purge.

tools.name: spinupwp_correct_file_permissions
tools.description: WRITE: reset a site's files and folders to the permissions and ownership SpinupWP recommends (usually after a manual upload as the wrong user). Can take a while on big sites. Asynchronous: returns an event_id. POST /sites/{id}/file-permissions/correct.

tools.name: spinupwp_deploy_site_git
tools.description: WRITE: pull the latest commit of the site's connected git branch and run its deploy script on the server. This changes the live site's files (and may run build/migration commands); it fails if git is not connected. Asynchronous: returns an event_id. POST /sites/{id}/git/deploy.

tools.name: spinupwp_restart_nginx
tools.description: WRITE: restart nginx (web server) on one server. Visitors may see a brief interruption. Asynchronous: returns an event_id. POST /servers/{id}/services/nginx/restart.

tools.name: spinupwp_restart_php
tools.description: WRITE: restart PHP-FPM (every PHP version) on one server. Running PHP requests can fail or be cut off while it restarts. Asynchronous: returns an event_id. POST /servers/{id}/services/php/restart.

tools.name: spinupwp_restart_mysql
tools.description: WRITE: restart MySQL (database) on one server. All sites on the server lose database access for a short time; running queries are interrupted. Asynchronous: returns an event_id. POST /servers/{id}/services/mysql/restart.

tools.name: spinupwp_restart_redis
tools.description: WRITE: restart Redis (object cache) on one server. Cached objects are lost and rebuilt on demand. Asynchronous: returns an event_id. POST /servers/{id}/services/redis/restart.

tools.name: spinupwp_reboot_server
tools.description: WRITE: reboot a whole server. Every site on it is offline for the duration (typically a minute or two). Use it when spinupwp_get_server shows reboot_required. Asynchronous: returns an event_id. POST /servers/{id}/reboot.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: spinupwp_list_sites, spinupwp_get_site · Private data: spinupwp_get_server, spinupwp_get_site, spinupwp_list_team_ssh_keys, spinupwp_correct_file_permissions, spinupwp_deploy_site_git, spinupwp_restart_mysql · Public sink: spinupwp_purge_page_cache, spinupwp_purge_object_cache, spinupwp_correct_file_permissions, spinupwp_deploy_site_git, spinupwp_restart_nginx, spinupwp_restart_php, spinupwp_restart_mysql, spinupwp_restart_redis, spinupwp_reboot_server · Destructive: spinupwp_correct_file_permissions, spinupwp_deploy_site_git.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: spinupwp_list_sites, spinupwp_get_site · Private data: spinupwp_get_server, spinupwp_get_site, spinupwp_list_team_ssh_keys, spinupwp_correct_file_permissions, spinupwp_deploy_site_git, spinupwp_restart_mysql · Public sink: spinupwp_purge_page_cache, spinupwp_purge_object_cache, spinupwp_correct_file_permissions, spinupwp_deploy_site_git, spinupwp_restart_nginx, spinupwp_restart_php, spinupwp_restart_mysql, spinupwp_restart_redis, spinupwp_reboot_server · Destructive: spinupwp_correct_file_permissions, spinupwp_deploy_site_git

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
